get_lightfield_rays: generate lightfield rays for a given U V grid with specified aspect ratio and near far planes
get_epi_rays: generate epipolar rays for a given U S grid with specified aspect ratio and near far planes
get_rays: compute ray origins and directions from camera directions and a camera to world transformation matrix
get_ray_directions_K: compute ray directions for an image grid given a camera intrinsic matrix K and image dimensions
sample_images_at_xy: sample pixel values from images at arbitrary xy coordinates using bilinear interpolation and grid sampling
